business_objective: Provide a controlled workflow for submitting, assigning, reviewing, and tracking lesson plans.

stakeholder_statements.text: I need to submit a lesson plan for review and see whether it is waiting, approved, or returned.
Reviewers should open submitted lesson plans, add feedback, and either approve them or return them to the teacher.
The department coordinator assigns each submitted lesson plan to a curriculum reviewer. A reviewer should only work on plans assigned to them.
Teachers may update a plan while it is still a draft, but once submitted they should not edit it unless it is returned.
We are not asking the tool to create lesson content; teachers will write the plans themselves.

business_objective: Coordinate walk-in waiting parties, table assignment, and table readiness during a restaurant shift.

stakeholder_statements.text: When a party arrives, I want to record the party name and size, then place them in the waiting queue.
I need to see available tables and assign a waiting party to one of them.
Once guests are seated, the assigned server should see the table as occupied and mark it ready for clearing after the party leaves.
The floor lead can mark a cleared table as available. Hosts should not make that change.
Online reservations are outside this project; this is only for walk-in seating during a shift.

business_objective: Provide a shared workflow for recording, reassigning, and resolving failed delivery attempts.

stakeholder_statements.text: If a delivery cannot be completed, the driver should choose a reason and leave a note before moving on.
Dispatch needs one place to see open delivery exceptions and reassign the stop when another driver is available. We did not decide how the replacement driver should be notified.
Customer service should record the customer's preferred next step, such as another attempt or pickup.
If the parcel is brought back, the warehouse clerk records that it has returned to the depot. Dispatch closes the exception only after the return is recorded or a new delivery is completed.
The old whiteboard has been in the dispatch room for years, and everyone complains about the marker smell. For this project, managers do not need route-planning or traffic-optimization features.

business_objective: Control the intake, routing, assignment, advice recording, and access of internal legal-help requests.

stakeholder_statements.text: Employees should submit a legal-help request with a summary.
The intake specialist sends incomplete requests back for missing information and routes complete requests to the appropriate legal practice.
The practice lead assigns routed requests to legal counsel. We have not agreed which practice categories will be available at launch.
Counsel records the final advice. The requester may view the final advice but not internal counsel notes.
Only the requester, intake specialist, assigned counsel, and relevant practice lead should access a matter. Emailing advice from the tool is not part of this release.

business_objective: Manage grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions.

stakeholder_statements.text: Applicants submit an application package.
After submission, the program officer checks eligibility. Eligible applications go to two reviewers, although we have not decided who selects them.
Reviewers add comments, and applicants should see each comment as soon as it is submitted.

The finance officer reviews the proposed budget only after the proposal reviews are complete. If the budget is not acceptable, it goes back for revision, but the statement did not identify who performs the revision.

The award approver records the final decision, and approved applicants should receive a notice. Comments must stay hidden from applicants until the final decision is recorded. The notice should go out quickly, and someone mentioned that the launch event will probably have better coffee this year.
